name: TTIR：dot 与 acc
title: 先看到两个运算：本块 dot，再加到旧 acc
added: tt.dot 的第三个操作数是零常量 %cst；循环携带的 %acc_8 出现在下一条 addf。
carried: 每个 K 块得到 FP32 部分积，跨 K 保持 FP32；所有 K 块结束才转 BF16。
decision: 不能直接把两个 SSA 名合成一个硬件累加模式；需要额外证明数值与布局等价。
sketch:
%acc_9 = tt.trans %b_tile_nk {order = array<i32: 1, 0>} : tensor<128x128xbf16> -> tensor<128x128xbf16>
          %acc_10 = tt.dot %a_tile, %acc_9, %cst : tensor<128x128xbf16> * tensor<128x128xbf16> -> tensor<128x128xf32>
          %acc_11 = arith.addf %acc_8, %acc_10 : tensor<128x128xf32>
          scf.yield %acc_11 : tensor<128x128xf32>

name: Linalg：存储显式化
title: 先表达 copy、transpose 与 matmul，给中端留下识别机会
added: 部分积 alloc_10 与跨 K 的 alloc_1 分开；linalg.add 原地更新后者。
carried: 权重的数学转置仍可见，尚未承诺执行一次物理 transpose。
decision: 中端可借助 weight 标记识别专用数据路径；先正确表示计算，再证明哪些搬运可以删除。
sketch:
%alloc_10 = memref.alloc() {alignment = 16 : i64} : memref<128x128xf32>
          memref.copy %alloc, %alloc_10 : memref<128x128xf32> to memref<128x128xf32>
          linalg.matmul ins(%alloc_6, %alloc_9 : memref<128x128xbf16>, memref<128x128xbf16>) outs(%alloc_10 : memref<128x128xf32>)
          linalg.add ins(%alloc_1, %alloc_10 : memref<128x128xf32>, memref<128x128xf32>) outs(%alloc_1 : memref<128x128xf32>)
        }
        %19 = arith.addi %18, %14 : index
        %reinterpret_cast_2 = memref.reinterpret_cast %arg2 to offset: [0], sizes: [%11, %12], strides: [%12, 1] {boundary_dims = array<i32: 0, 1>} : memref<*xbf16> to memref<?x?xbf16, strided<[?, 1]>>

name: High：权重布局
title: 逻辑列位置变成专用打包地址
decision: weight offset 已是字节；不能用普通行主序的128×260×2代替，也不能与fmap尚未换算的元素偏移混用。
sketch:
%26 = arith.muli %23, %14 : i32
        %27 = arith.muli %26, %c2_i32 : i32
        %28 = zeus_high.create_weight_desc %0 {offset = 0, tensor_shape = [1, 128, %7], tile_shape = [1, 128, 128], blocked_offset = %27, memory_space = "LDG"} : memref<1xbf16> -> !zeus_high.weight_desc
        %29 = zeus_high.update_tile %24 [1, 1, %21, 128] : !zeus_high.fmap_desc -> !zeus_high.fmap_desc

name: High：有效窗口
title: 固定SRAM几何，按消费者更新本轮范围
added: PE 输入K被裁成min(K−k_start,128)；PE输出的N仍是128。
decision: 这份产物显式表达各阶段访问范围；完整合同仍需布局与运行验收，也不能据此宣称消除了N尾冗余计算。
sketch:
%56 = zeus_high.update_tile %28 [1, 128, %55] : !zeus_high.weight_desc -> !zeus_high.weight_desc
          %57 = zeus_high.set_pos %56 [0, 0, %43] : !zeus_high.weight_desc -> !zeus_high.weight_desc
          %58 = zeus_high.update_tile %44 [1, 1, %19, %55] : !zeus_high.fmap_desc -> !zeus_high.fmap_desc
          %59 = zeus_high.set_pos %58 [0, 0, 0, 0] : !zeus_high.fmap_desc -> !zeus_high.fmap_desc
          %60 = zeus_high.update_tile %54 [1, 1, %19, 128] : !zeus_high.fmap_desc -> !zeus_high.fmap_desc
          %61 = zeus_high.set_pos %60 [0, 0, 0, 0] : !zeus_high.fmap_desc -> !zeus_high.fmap_desc
          zeus_high.pe %alloc_1, %0, %alloc_2 desc(%59, %57, %61) {mtc = 2 : i64, mtk = 1 : i64, mtw = 4 : i64, op_type = "matmul", transpose_lhs = false, transpose_rhs = false, wbs = 128 : i64, ymode = "KC"} : memref<1x1x128x128xbf16>, memref<1xbf16>, memref<1x1x128x128xf32>

name: Low：PE 命令
title: 高层数学算子变成描述符驱动的执行命令
added: breg取代高层descriptor类型；pe_compute显式携带dtype、WBS和minitile等属性。
carried: FP32部分积目的块仍是单独的L2区间，后面由VP消费。
decision: 配置合法、物理数据就绪与结果数值正确是三个不同问题；此时尚未注入完整同步。
sketch: zeus_low.pe_compute %194, %145, %65 {carry_mode = "round", dst_dtype = "FP32", mtc = 2 : i32, mtk = 1 : i32, mtw = 4 : i32, src_a_dtype = "BF16", wbs = 128 : i32, weight_dtype = "BF16", weight_mode = "normal", ymode = "KC", zeus.weight_dram_array = 0 : i64, zeus.weight_dram_slab = 0 : i64, zeus.weight_dram_slot = -1 : i64} : <act, l2>, <act, l2>, <weight, wdram>

name: CFG：循环与 φ
title: K 循环变成有入口、回边和退出边的基本块
added: 循环计数通过block argument传递；随后标量下降会把边界min/max展开为菱形分支。
carried: K=260只作代入：动态循环执行次数是ceil(K/128)，不能在编译时假装总是3。
decision: 边上的值传递还要在寄存器分配时落实；signed比较不能随意丢掉溢出语义。
sketch:
cf.br ^bb5(%c0_i32_1 : i32)
  ^bb5(%249: i32):  // 2 preds: ^bb4, ^bb6
    %250 = arith.cmpi slt, %249, %30 : i32
    cf.cond_br %250, ^bb6, ^bb7
  ^bb6:  // pred: ^bb5
    %251 = arith.muli %249, %c128_i32 : i32
    %252 = arith.index_cast %251 : i32 to index

// Backedge
    %277 = arith.addi %249, %c1_i32_2 : i32
    cf.br ^bb5(%277 : i32)

name: Sync：返回通知
title: MAIL 同时保护生产消费和下一轮覆盖
added: LD等待PE，PE等待LD+VP，VP等待PE；反向边归还可复用的A和partial槽位。
carried: 配置/地址已知，算法与dtype未改变。进入和退出K循环还有seed/drain。
decision: 只沿LD→PE→VP看RAW不够；循环WAR、计数与无tag顺序必须一起成立。

    zeus_low.pe_compute %77, %66, %61 {carry_mode = "round", dst_dtype = "FP32", mtc = 2 : i32, mtk = 1 : i32, mtw = 4 : i32, recv_mails = ["LD", "VP"], send_mails = ["VP", "LD"], src_a_dtype = "BF16", wbs = 128 : i32, weight_dtype = "BF16", weight_mode = "normal", ymode = "KC", zeus.weight_dram_array = 0 : i64, zeus.weight_dram_slab = 0 : i64, zeus.weight_dram_slot = -1 : i64} : <act, l2>, <act, l2>, <weight, wdram>
    zeus_low.vp_compute %80, %54, %54, %77, exec_unit unit0 {operandSegmentSizes = array<i32: 1, 1, 1, 1>, recv_mails = ["PE", "VP"], send_mails = ["PE"]} : !zeus_low.token, !zeus_low.breg<act, l2>

name: ASM：实际 spill
title: 一个 M 块数实际被 spill 到 VR，再在循环头恢复
added: CodeGen插入get_spill_vreg、reg2vreg与vreg2reg；最后映射到VR3槽0的CT指令。
carried: 搬的是控制标量，和128×128张量的SRAM地址分配是不同资源。
decision: 当前路径自有代码生成，但寄存器压力、phi复制、选择、合法化并没有消失。

  CT_ADD_R_R_R Rx[26] Ra[26] Rb[25]
